tenders.title: RFP for Service Provider Selection for BGSSL Inbound & Outbound Call Centre Solution
tenders.scope_summary: BGSSL is seeking proposals from service providers for an Inbound & Outbound Call Centre Solution. The solution should include features like lead recycling, DNC management, and reporting capabilities.
key_points: The RFP document outlines requirements for an inbound and outbound call centre solution.
The service provider will be responsible for setting up and operating the call centre.
The company reserves the right to amend or reject any responses.
The information provided by bidders will become the property of BGSSL.
